name: Szabadszentkirály (Hungary)
description: Two horizontal stripes of blue over white in the ratio 3:2, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szabadszentkirály: a blue shield with a yellow figure of Saint Stephen on a green mound, bordered in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
